goal: Run drive and agent sessions as background jobs that hold their lease until terminal, add job_finished and lane_settled events, resume enrolled tasks instead of re-enrolling, record the settled commit and verification digest, and open the PR on settlement, per D6 of docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md.

acceptance.assertion: Source BR-SCN-6, BR-GAP-5, BR-GAP-B1, BR-GAP-B2, BR-GAP-B3, BR-GAP-B5; meet D6 in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-async-drive.test.ts and tests/loop-daemon-drive-pr.test.ts with a fake Lane that settles after more than one tick. Done looks like: an approved task's drive outlives the tick, a later tick observes lane_settled from the Kernel projection, the exit record carries final_commit_sha and the verification digest, and open_pr opens the pull request with no second approval. Negative: a settlement without a commit digest opens no PR and records failed.

Source BR-GAP-B4; meet D6 re-entry bullet in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-async-drive.test.ts. Done looks like: re-entry for an enrolled nonterminal task resumes through drive_dispatcher. Negative: no enrollment is attempted for a task whose TaskRecord exists. Bound: a job whose pid is dead with no outcome is marked lost, retried once, then escalated.

Source BR-GAP-1, BR-GAP-D; meet D6 in docs/specs/loop-agent-scheduling.spec.md. Agreed seam: tests/loop-sched-async-drive.test.ts and tests/loop-daemon-dispatch.test.ts. Done looks like: tick returns while a job runs and an owner command arriving meanwhile is handled on the next tick. Negative: with max_concurrent jobs running, the next agent candidate is held. Bound: the lease is released only when the job record is terminal.
